title: OTP Verify Screen with Input, Resend Timer, Attempt Counter, and Lockout Message
description: The frontend module shall display an OTP verify screen with 6-digit input, resend timer, attempt counter, and lockout message.
rationale: Users must know how many attempts remain before lockout to avoid being locked out accidentally; the resend timer prevents abuse while the lockout message provides a clear recovery path when the attempt cap is reached.
